_comment: Settled verdicts for rows of patterns/wildcard-review.tsv. A SIDECAR, not edits to the TSV: scripts/rewrite-unbounded-wildcards.js (writeReviewTsv) rewrites the whole TSV from its own run on every --write, so a verdict typed into it would be lost. Keyed by the TSV's own columns (channel, technology as in the `technologies` column, the ORIGINAL pattern in `pattern`). tests/review-settlements.test.js requires every row the TSV tags `possible-genuine-loss` to have an entry here and every entry to name a row still in the TSV, so a regenerated TSV with new or vanished rows fails the build until they are settled here. Verdicts: correct-loss (every lost match was a false positive), no-loss (the technology is still detected by other rules), genuine-loss (a real detection was lost), signal-kept-below-floor (the lost rule only double-counted a real marker that another rule still matches, at a confidence under the ledger floor). Evidence: the 2026-10-08 census re-run, ~/LLM/speedyu-data/detechtor-census-2026-10-08/rerun-2944458/RERUN.md section 2 (lost_jobs.json: the 173 lost pairs, read one by one).
